_comment: Same-host fairness audit (2026-07-17): all measured in the Mersey Chromium fork (DCHECK + libc++ extensive hardening; is_official_build=false) over file://, headless=new, n=3 medians. JS is plain hand-written JS; native is the Mersey Tier-1 JIT. This removes the origin (http vs file://) and browser-build (stock release vs fork) confounds present in the main chart, where JS/poly/tjs run in stock release browsers over http. Caveat: the Mersey engine .so is a release build while the fork's V8 is DCHECK'd, so these margins still overstate the pure engine gap somewhat.

env.build: is_debug=false, dcheck_always_on=true, libc++ extensive hardening, is_official_build=false
